messages:
emily: quick sync — PM wants canary cost cards to show token spend vs cache savings. Totals hide KV wins. Screenshot: https://our.internal/snap.png :eyes:

sid: agree. Proposal: emit a compact snapshot at snapshot_time (one row per route+variant). Minimal fields: route, variant, invocations, tokens_billed, cache_saved_tokens, token_cost_cents, baseline_snapshot_id, reasons[], approx. Keep payload tiny so no full timeseries re-ingest.

mark: UX: paired bars — red = billed spend, green = cache savings (display as reduction). add toggle: per-invocation vs per-token and a normalized net_delta_per_1k_invokes. Tooltip with cents + token counts. CSV export please.

emily: Product also wants a short "why" pill (model_swap|token_shift|prompt_change) + confidence. Heuristics must be simple and explainable.

sid: heuristic sketch: if variant_id != baseline -> model_swap; if median tokens shift > 20% -> token_shift; if prompt overlap < 60% -> prompt_change. Confidence = f(sample_size, magnitude). Mark approx=true if sample_size < 200.

ingest-bot: snapshot recorded rollout=canary-2026-04-14T11:10Z by @emily (3 rows uploaded)

mark: Action items: sid -> draft POST /internal/v1/snapshots contract + example payload (ETA Tue). I'll mock UI and add CSV export (ETA Wed). emily -> update rollout runbook and retention request.

emily: thanks, keeping this thread as the decision log. :thumbsup:
